name: crypto-lab-threshold-mldsa
description: Browser-based educational demo of threshold lattice signing, shown from both sides: an ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) two-party split-custody path that emits a standard-verifying signature by combining the key shares, and a never-combine two-party module-SIS protocol at toy parameters with its own verifier, real rejection sampling and a breakable z-share. Neither claims what the other provides.
